summary: Learn regulatory reform and better regulation methods to assess burden, design clearer rules, and build credible reform roadmaps.
lede: Regulatory reform training helps policy, legal, compliance, and oversight professionals diagnose rule problems and develop practical, proportionate changes. Participants learn to assess regulatory impacts and administrative burden, compare risk-based and performance-based options, and plan stakeholder consultation. They also practise creating implementation checklists, monitoring scorecards, and reform roadmaps to support clear, evidence-based decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work on the design, review, implementation, or oversight of regulatory systems and need practical tools to improve rule quality. Policy Officers responsible for drafting and reviewing reform proposals. Regulatory Analysts measuring burden, risk, and compliance impacts. Legislative Drafters translating reform intent into clear rule text. Compliance Managers aligning internal controls with new regulatory requirements. Regulatory Affairs Specialists coordinating responses to rule changes. Public Sector Reform Managers sequencing implementation and approval steps. Enforcement Officers refining guidance and escalation pathways. Consultation Leads synthesising stakeholder comments into reform decisions. Legal and Policy Advisers reviewing proportionality and enforceability. Governance Analysts supporting regulatory reporting and oversight.
modules: Regulatory Impact Assessment and Burden Analysis
prerequisites: Bring a laptop for workshop exercises, especially the consultation mapping and scorecard activities. A current regulation, draft reform issue, or internal compliance challenge is strongly recommended so you can produce realistic deliverables during the course.
